output: finite little-endian float64 sequence; output order declared in semantics
semantics: CPU float64 fit with intercept, in-sample prediction, coefficient export and residual sum of squares. Swift public LinearRegression CPU API attempts analytical QR and has a gradient-descent fallback; Python uses scipy.linalg.lstsq with gelsy. No identical solver claim. Output: intercept, feature-order coefficients, residual sum of squares, all row-order predictions. Input decoding is outside timing; construction, fitting and complete numeric output are inside. Dataset selects the original-decimal or exact-binary64-input reference.
